THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
SHILLONG
NOTICE
NO.HCM.II1/1 66/2019-JudI./Part-1/602 Dated Shillong, the 01 “ October, 2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all concerned that cases listed before the
Division Benches and Single Benches on Monday, the 05th October, 2026, and on
subsequent dates will be taken up.
All advocates/parties concerned are requested to ensure their appearance in the cases
listed, failing which such cases may be dismissed for non-prosecution or taken up and
decided on merits, as the Court may deem appropriate.
By Order./
JOINT REGISTRAR (LISTING)
